2610.04272.title: Rethinking Self-Distillation for Multi-Teacher Capability Merging
2610.04272.paper_summary: Combining capabilities of multiple expert models trained starting from the same base checkpoint has become increasingly common in frontier language-model post-training. Recent trends suggest that multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) outperforms conventional off-policy methods. However, despite the higher inference and environment interaction costs incurred by MOPD, we find that much of its reported accuracy gain is due to certain training design choices and hyperparameter optimization, rather than the algorithm itself. We conduct a controlled self-distillation study across two multi-teacher settings, four models, and eleven benchmarks, comparing off-policy methods, namely supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and soft-label distillation, to hybrid teacher-prefix distillation and MOPD. We found that all four methods achieve \textit{nearly identical} accuracy. However, MOPD uses $14.8$--$23.1\times$ SFT's training GPU-hours. We also revisit four recently published comparisons between on-policy and off-policy distillation and find that the reported on-policy gains shrink substantially when SFT baselines are trained on rejection-sampled teacher trajectories and use independently tuned hyperparameters. As a training-free alternative, we also find that simple weight-merging methods can recover expert capabilities with minutes of CPU merging time, although their accuracy degrades as model size decreases and task interference increases. Overall, our results question recent gains reported due to MOPD and suggest careful tuning of more efficient off-policy baselines as a viable alternative.
2610.04272.paper_summary_zh: 結合從相同基準檢查點開始訓練的多個專家模型的能力，在前沿語言模型後訓練中變得越來越普遍。最近的趨勢表明，多教師在政策蒸餾（MOPD）優於傳統的離政策方法。然而，儘管MOPD產生了更高的推理和環境互動成本，我們發現其報告的準確性增益在很大程度上是由於某些訓練設計選擇和超參數優化，而不是算法本身。我們在兩個多教師設置、四個模型和十一個基準上進行了受控的自我蒸餾研究，將離政策方法（即監督微調（SFT）和軟標籤蒸餾）與混合教師前綴蒸餾和MOPD進行比較。我們發現這四種方法的準確性\textit{幾乎相同}。然而，MOPD使用了$14.8$--$23.1\times$ SFT的訓練GPU小時。我們還重新檢視了四個最近發表的關於在政策和離政策蒸餾之間的比較，發現當SFT基準在拒絕抽樣的教師軌跡上訓練並使用獨立調整的超參數時，報告的在政策增益顯著縮小。作為一種無需訓練的替代方案，我們還發現簡單的權重合併方法可以在幾分鐘的CPU合併時間內恢復專家能力，儘管隨著模型大小減小和任務干擾增加，它們的準確性會下降。總的來說，我們的結果質疑了最近報告的由於MOPD而產生的增益，並建議仔細調整更高效的離政策基準作為可行的替代方案。
